text:
aaron: FYI deploy-bot aborted the staging push for ml-features:pr-4012. finalize returned a different manifest digest than client computed.

deploy-bot: publish aborted: finalize_digest_mismatch. details:
  tag=staging-pr-4012
  computed=sha256:aa11ee...
  finalized=sha256:aa22ff...
  action=abort

tia: that's odd. was the artifact mirrored elsewhere before finalize? could be a mirror applying a manifest rewrite.

infra-runner: quick check: mirror job to gcr-eu started at 2025-10-20T11:07:12Z, but mirror-proxy-7 logged multiple 504s during 11:07:10-11:07:20Z.

azoe: pinging infra to confirm S3 multipart reassembly. @infra-runner any S3 or proxy errors in us-east for that timeframe?

infra-runner: S3 shows chunk retries from build-host-9. proxy logs show a 504 then a 200. looks like client retried and finalize saw a different ordering. ticket INF-2041 opened.

tia: temporary mitigation: pin deploy/rollout to last-known-good digest sha256:88bb44... and hold promotion. we'll republish from CI cache with no rebuild and attach provenance.

deploy-bot: previous_good_digest for ml-features (staging) -> sha256:88bb44...

release-manager: approve hold. remove this image from today's EU promote window and add note to release notes: "ml-features staging publish held; republish + verification in progress."

azoe: republish commands I'll run (reuse cached artifact id ci-art-4022):
```
publishbot republish --artifact ci-art-4022 --tag staging-repub-4022 --force
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign service@staging-repub-4022
provenance attach --artifact staging-repub-4022 --file attestation.json
```

infra-runner: enabling extra finalize checksum assertion in publishbot for this run. if finalize digest != computed, publishbot will auto-retry finalize up to 3 times before abort.

deploy-bot: republish started: ci-art-4022 -> staging-repub-4022. watch: https://publishbot.internal/ops/4022

tia: also note to ops: add auto-rotate policy for mirror-proxy-7 if 5xx > 5/min.

azoe: cosign verify succeeded, attestation attached, provenance verified for staging-repub-4022 -> sha256:88bb44...

deploy-bot: republish complete. staging tag staging-repub-4022 pinned to sha256:88bb44...

tia: running quick canary now. will report back in 20m.

release-manager: leaving hold in changelog until canary green. will schedule manual promote out of EU window tomorrow morning.

aaron: thanks everyone. postmortem: include mirror-proxy 5xx spike and publishbot finalize retry enhancement.
